## Privacy checklist

- [ ] Identity secrets, passphrases and backup phrases never leave the browser
- [ ] No new link between `issuer.*` and `verifier.*` data (no FKs, no shared logs)
- [ ] No IPs, Telegram user IDs or PII stored or logged on prove/verify routes
- [ ] Threat model (docs/PRODUCT.md / docs/THREAT-MODEL.md) still accurate
